style.backgroundSystem: deep crimson #9E1F35 festive panels alternating with ivory cream #F7F0E6 content panels and one dark walnut tea-table scene

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent festive premium mooncake gifting visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep crimson #9E1F35, ivory cream #F7F0E6, warm gold #C9A063 and walnut brown #4A3226; warm soft studio lighting with soft contact shadows and candle-warm ambience for the dark tea scene; classic elegant serif typography with warm gold accents; thin gold line icons and empty rounded label tags; raw wooden risers and walnut boards as surfaces; stable product scale with whole pieces and cut pieces showing the filling; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no product scale jumps between shots
style.presentationRules: whole mooncakes and cut pieces showing the filling presented on wooden risers at a stable scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: raw wooden stump risers, walnut table boards and matte ivory boards
style.typography: classic elegant serif for festive headlines with slim sans-serif labels, warm gold rendering
